# Existing release HIP fixture

`release-existing.hiplc` is a synthetic Houdini 22.0.466 Indie scene generated by the `prepare` mode of `tests/houdini_offline_datablock_probe.py`. It was created before the maintained release workflow, with no artist scene content, as the original scene for the November 7 native archive experiment.

SHA-256: `52b0178f09fbef2fc2274bcd2b120ce5e59876fb55a2370fe39746af3e4bf9da` (18,654 bytes). On 2026-11-20 the machine paths in its HIP, HIPFILE, JOB and POSE variables and the user@computer `author` stamps were replaced in place by neutral text of the same length (`C:/source/Cycles_Houdini_repo`, `user@machine`); nothing else changed, so it is still the scene the old build saved. `legacy-rgba-color-ramps.hiplc` was treated the same way. The original bytes had SHA-256 `7377c127...251f1`.

The authored material `/mat/offline_test` is `cycles::material::1`. Its `surface_shader` is `cycles::principled_bsdf::1`, with roughness `.314159`; it connects to `surface_output` (`cycles::surface_output::1`). It also contains the prototype binary data block on `/obj`. `houdini_release_existing_hip_smoke.py` checks the healthy existing graph and value without saving the file. This intentionally small fixture does not represent the full offline graph/recovery matrix.
